cues.en: Mike: Now I'm going to show you how to create box-and-whisker plots or boxplots in MATLAB and then in Python.
cues.zh: 現在示範如何在MATLAB，接著在Python，建立盒鬚圖，也就是盒形圖。

cues.en: It's actually pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 其實很直接。

cues.en: I'm gonna start by creating data.
cues.zh: 先建立資料。

cues.en: This is exactly the same way I created data on the previous code video, so the video for creating bar plots.
cues.zh: 和上一部長條圖實作影片，產生資料的方式完全相同。

cues.en: So all the same code here, I just copied and pasted it, and now it's pretty simple.
cues.zh: 這裡的程式碼都相同，直接複製貼上，現在很簡單。

cues.en: All we have to do is use the function boxplot.
cues.zh: 只要使用boxplot函式。

cues.en: So MATLAB does all the hard work for us.
cues.zh: MATLAB替我們完成所有困難的工作。

cues.en: And here you can see all of the main features of the boxplot that I explained in the previous video.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，前一部影片解釋的盒形圖主要特徵。

cues.en: So here we have the median with the red lines, and then the quartile one and quartile three, and the minimum and maximum data.
cues.zh: 紅線是中位數，接著第一與第三四分位數，以及資料最小值與最大值。

cues.en: So again, the idea, the key idea of interpreting a box plot is that 50% of the data are contained inside this box.
cues.zh: 解讀盒形圖的關鍵，是50%的資料包含在盒子裡。

cues.en: So these are the values here where 50% of the data lie.
cues.zh: 這裡的數值範圍，就有50%的資料。

cues.en: And then we have a couple of outliers.
cues.zh: 接著有幾個離群值。

cues.en: Well, I guess just, it looks like two outliers here.
cues.zh: 看起來大概有兩個。

cues.en: This one is questionable, whether it would really be considered an outlier, but we'll discuss this in more detail later in the course.
cues.zh: 這一個是否真的算離群值，值得討論，稍後課程會更詳細說明。

cues.en: This one does kind of look a little bit more like an outlier.
cues.zh: 這一個看起來就比較像離群值。

cues.en: So it's pretty interesting to compare the boxplots to the error bar plots that we created two videos ago.
cues.zh: 和前兩部影片建立的誤差線圖比較，很有意思。

cues.en: In some sense, they show basically the same information.
cues.zh: 某種程度而言，基本上顯示相同資訊。

cues.en: It's just displayed in a slightly different way.
cues.zh: 只是呈現方式稍有不同。

cues.en: I find these boxplots to be more informative than the error bar plots.
cues.zh: 我覺得盒形圖比誤差線圖提供更多資訊。

cues.en: And what's even better than a barplot is something called a violin plot.
cues.zh: 比長條圖更好的，還有一種叫小提琴圖。

cues.en: That's a really beautiful way of visualizing the data.
cues.zh: 那是非常漂亮的資料視覺化方式。

cues.en: But to know how to make a violin plot, you have to know a little bit more about descriptive statistics.
cues.zh: 但要知道如何建立小提琴圖，必須先了解更多敘述統計。

cues.en: So I'm going to introduce you to violin plots in the next section.
cues.zh: 所以下一節會介紹小提琴圖。

cues.en: Okay, so now this is basically, you know, this is sort of it.
cues.zh: 基本上就是這樣。

cues.en: We, we just say boxplot and then data.
cues.zh: 只要呼叫boxplot，再給data。

cues.en: And notice that MATLAB automatically by default grouped the data into columns.
cues.zh: 注意，MATLAB預設自動把資料依欄分組。

cues.en: So it says 30 by 60.
cues.zh: 所以這是30×6。

cues.en: I suppose we could, you know, see what it would look like the other way.
cues.zh: 也可以看看換個方向會怎樣。

cues.en: But then we just end up with a lot of boxplots here.
cues.zh: 但就會得到很多盒形圖。

cues.en: Okay, and then what I'm illustrating here in this next line is that we can provide a second input.
cues.zh: 下一行示範，可以提供第二個輸入。

cues.en: In this case, I'm giving a cell array of characters, and that's just going to automatically label the x axis coordinate.
cues.zh: 這裡給的是字元cell陣列，會自動為x軸座標加標籤。

cues.en: So this is boxplot one, two, three, and so on.
cues.zh: 所以這是盒形圖一、二、三，依此類推。

cues.en: These are all made up data, so I don't really have any very interesting names to give them.
cues.zh: 全是編造的資料，所以沒有什麼有趣名稱可取。

cues.en: If you like, you could give these different names.
cues.zh: 願意的話，可以給不同名稱。

cues.en: So here our data were organized already into a matrix of observations by features.
cues.zh: 這裡的資料，已整理成觀測值×特徵的矩陣。

cues.en: So 30 observations and six features.
cues.zh: 也就是30個觀測值、6個特徵。

cues.en: Sometimes you don't have your data organized like that.
cues.zh: 有時資料沒有這樣整理。

cues.en: Sometimes you have data that are organized just into one really long vector, like what you see here.
cues.zh: 有時只是整理成一條非常長的向量，就像這裡。

cues.en: So all I've done is used this colon operator to vectorize this data set.
cues.zh: 我只是用冒號運算子，把資料集向量化。

cues.en: So now if you just make a a boxplot of this, MATLAB is gonna think that you have exactly one piece of data.
cues.zh: 現在若直接畫盒形圖，MATLAB會以為你只有一組資料。

cues.en: So MATLAB is just gonna create one boxplot.
cues.zh: 所以只產生一個盒形圖。

cues.en: That would be all of this information pooled.
cues.zh: 把這些資訊全部合在一起。

cues.en: So then what we need to do is have a separate vector that indicates the grouping.
cues.zh: 需要另外一個向量，指出分組。

cues.en: So let me dump this out so this is clear.
cues.zh: 把它列印出來，講清楚。

cues.en: So what I have here is a separate grouping vector.
cues.zh: 這裡是另一個分組向量。

cues.en: So this is 180 elements long, and that's because data is 30 by 60.
cues.zh: 長度是180個元素，因為data是30×6。

cues.en: So data vectorized is 180.
cues.zh: 所以data向量化後是180。

cues.en: So this is basically, the way of telling MATLAB that data point number 145 corresponds to group five and so on.
cues.zh: 基本上，是告訴MATLAB，第145個資料點對應第五組，依此類推。

cues.en: Okay, so then we can make a boxplot of this and well, this looks basically the same, so it's all the same information.
cues.zh: 接著畫盒形圖，基本上看起來相同，資訊完全一樣。

cues.en: This is really just to show you a way of having the data be organized in a vector.
cues.zh: 只是示範，資料整理成向量時的做法。

cues.en: Now, of course, the plots don't look exactly the same because here I added an additional parameter and that's notch on.
cues.zh: 當然，圖表不完全相同，因為這裡多加一個參數，notch設為on。

cues.en: So that kind of, it looks like it's wearing a belt that's really tight around its waist here.
cues.zh: 看起來像腰上繫了一條非常緊的腰帶。

cues.en: So you can see the difference.
cues.zh: 可以看到差別。

cues.en: It's really just for aesthetic purposes.
cues.zh: 其實只是為了美觀。

cues.en: It's not really too much different otherwise.
cues.zh: 除此之外，沒有太大不同。

cues.en: There's lots of other customizations that you can make on the barplots.
cues.zh: 長條圖還有很多其他能自訂的選項。

cues.en: You can change all the colors, you can change the face colors instead of this being empty white, you could make this on a green or purple, all sorts of things that you can change.
cues.zh: 能改所有顏色、改填色，不一定是空白，可以改成綠色、紫色，各種東西都能改。

cues.en: But you know, that's sort of something you can do on your own.
cues.zh: 不過，這些可以自己試。

cues.en: And the last thing I wanna show you here is just that you can add another option to say orientation horizontal.
cues.zh: 最後要示範，加另一個選項，orientation設為horizontal。

cues.en: And that's going to give us a horizontal oriented boxplot.
cues.zh: 會得到水平方向的盒形圖。

cues.en: So like this, so all the same data, everything is the same.
cues.zh: 就像這樣，資料全部相同，一切相同。

cues.en: We just rotated everything.
cues.zh: 只是把整體旋轉。

cues.en: So now we have the boxplots on the y axis and the data values on the x axis.
cues.zh: 現在盒形圖位於y軸，資料值位於x軸。

cues.en: All right, so here we are in Python, we are going to make box-and-whisker plots, or some often just called boxplots for short,
cues.zh: 現在來到Python，要建立盒鬚圖，也常簡稱盒形圖，

cues.en: using matplotlib, we'll use numpy a little bit for, yeah, organizing the data and calling some functions.
cues.zh: 使用matplotlib，也會稍微用NumPy整理資料、呼叫函式。

cues.en: I'm going to put the data into a Pandas data frame and use another library called Seaborn.
cues.zh: 把資料放進Pandas DataFrame，還用另一個叫Seaborn的程式庫。

cues.en: And Seaborn is basically just a package that has some nice visualizations built into it.
cues.zh: Seaborn基本上是內建一些漂亮視覺化的套件。

cues.en: So run that code.
cues.zh: 執行程式碼。

cues.en: Here I'm creating the data.
cues.zh: 這裡建立資料。

cues.en: This is exactly the same way that I created the data in the previous code video.
cues.zh: 和上一部程式實作影片，建立資料的方法完全相同。

cues.en: So about the bar plots, it's all the same code I just copied and pasted it.
cues.zh: 也就是長條圖影片，程式碼都相同，直接複製貼上。

cues.en: Okay, so creating a box plot is really simple.
cues.zh: 建立盒形圖很簡單。

cues.en: We just use this function boxplots and we input our data matrix and notice that Python knows, or you know, assumes that the data are organized
cues.zh: 使用boxplot函式，輸入資料矩陣。注意，Python知道，或假設資料排列為，

cues.en: as observations by features.
cues.zh: 觀測值×特徵。

cues.en: So each column in the data corresponds to a different box in this plot.
cues.zh: 所以資料每一欄，對應這張圖中不同的盒子。

cues.en: So for example, we could transpose the matrix and we would get a quite a different looking plot.
cues.zh: 例如，把矩陣轉置，就得到看起來相當不同的圖。

cues.en: So now we are looking at boxplots over the rows of the matrix, which are the columns of the matrix transposed.
cues.zh: 現在看的盒形圖，跨原矩陣的列，也就是轉置矩陣的欄。

cues.en: Okay, so now I'm going to replot, regenerate, let me go back to this.
cues.zh: 現在重新畫、重新產生，先回到這裡。

cues.en: I'm gonna regenerate this plot in Seaborn, so that's sns, without adding anything specials, I'm not giving any special inputs.
cues.zh: 用Seaborn，也就是sns，重新產生圖，不加入特殊內容，不提供特殊輸入。

cues.en: And just to see, just to show you what the difference is.
cues.zh: 只是看看、展示差異。

cues.en: So it's not hugely different.
cues.zh: 沒有非常大的差別。

cues.en: The bars look a little bit different.
cues.zh: 長條看起來稍微不同。

cues.en: It automatically attaches colors.
cues.zh: 它會自動加上顏色。

cues.en: And we get here, there were circles to indicate the outliers here, they're diamonds, but I think this does look a little bit nicer.
cues.zh: 這裡原本用圓圈表示離群值，這裡是菱形，但我覺得確實好看一些。

cues.en: Here I have this optional input orient equals V.
cues.zh: 這裡有選用輸入orient='v'。

cues.en: So this is for vertical orientation.
cues.zh: 代表垂直方向。

cues.en: If you don't specify this, the default is to have horizontal orientation.
cues.zh: 如果不指定，預設是水平方向。

cues.en: And I'm gonna show you that on here, on the next cell.
cues.zh: 下一個儲存格會示範。

cues.en: So now what I'm doing is importing the data into a Pandas data frame.
cues.zh: 現在把資料匯入Pandas DataFrame。

cues.en: And I'm also specifying the column.
cues.zh: 也指定欄名。

cues.en: So these columns are, well, you know, these are fake data, they're just made up numbers.
cues.zh: 這些是假資料，只是編造的數字。

cues.en: So we don't have anything particularly special to call these columns.
cues.zh: 所以沒有什麼特別名稱能給這些欄。

cues.en: So I just called them zero up through five.
cues.zh: 就叫0到5。

cues.en: And then again, I'm using Seaborn to generate a boxplot of this data frame.
cues.zh: 接著同樣用Seaborn，產生這個DataFrame的盒形圖。

cues.en: And now it's gonna be a horizontal orientation.
cues.zh: 這次是水平方向。

cues.en: And this shows you exactly the same information as displayed here.
cues.zh: 展示的資訊與這裡完全相同。

cues.en: It's just rotated 90 degrees.
cues.zh: 只是旋轉90度。

cues.en: So there are more options if you want to continue exploring how to use Seaborn to create a boxplot.
cues.zh: 如果想繼續探索用Seaborn建立盒形圖，還有更多選項。

cues.en: You can look up the doc string, the help message.
cues.zh: 可以查docstring，也就是說明文字。

cues.en: And one way to do that is by putting your cursor inside the function call here, and then you press Shift + Tab on your keyboard and that opens up this window,
cues.zh: 一個方法，是把游標放在這裡的函式呼叫裡，按鍵盤Shift+Tab，就會開啟這個視窗，

cues.en: which is actually just a quick preview.
cues.zh: 其實只是快速預覽。

cues.en: So you can click on the plus sign and you can see it's quite, it's a pretty long doc string.
cues.zh: 可以點加號，會看到相當長的docstring。

cues.en: So there's quite a lot of options and yeah, there's also some examples that you can use to play around with the various options.
cues.zh: 有很多選項，也有一些範例，讓你嘗試各種設定。
